title: Entry Conatus — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Entry Conatus's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. pieces.caption: The opening words of 311 forward vectors. A hundred begin 'I want to'. Sixty-nine begin 'I am', the opening the page calls a stasis-verb. *What is real and what is a choice:* A count of openings, not a judgment of any page: many 'I am' vectors go on to want something.

verdicts.file: Entry Conatus — rich — how the pages begin their wish.svg
verdicts.why: A chart, but it turns the page's own rule on the palace's own vectors, and the honesty line owns the limit well. The red count is short by two: 69 vectors begin "I am", not 67. The script cannot read a forward vector written as a YAML block, and the two it missed (Drafting Table Design System, Loudon Live Design System) both begin "I am". Fix the reader, then 69 and "53 begin some other way" in image and caption.
